title: Tropical Thailand | Hidden Islands and Timeless Tales
highlights: Discover Pattaya's vibrant nightlife, dive into Bangkok's bustling markets, then relax on Phi Phi Island's stunning beaches.
Explore the Phi Phi Islands, where you can dive into turquoise waters, marvel at dramatic cliffs, and enjoy vibrant marine life.
Relax on pristine beaches of Coral Island (Koh Larn), snorkel in clear waters, and enjoy various water sports.
Enjoy a Chao Phraya River dinner cruise, where you can savor delicious cuisine while gliding past Bangkok's temples and skyline.
Observe a diverse range of wildlife at the Safari World in Bangkok, and explore both the open zoo and marine park.
overview:
About the destination:
Phuket, the biggest island in Thailand, enveloped in the Andaman Sea, has a grace that lures travellers worldwide. Its white shimmering beaches amidst the turquoise waters and limestone cliffs is a sight to behold. It is a slice of heaven with its tropical appeal, beautiful shrines, rich culture, graceful architecture and exotic cuisines make it a must-visit place for every traveller. Phuket's sparkling nightlife is one of the many reasons that attract travellers who seek a thrilling time in the beautiful environment. Bangkok is the capital city and the chief port of Thailand, widely known as Thailand's cultural and commercial centre. This city is quite popular amongst tourists because of its rich history, beautiful architecture.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Bangkok | Transfer to Pattaya
days.desc: Welcome to Bangkok, the capital of Thailand! Upon arrival at the Bangkok Airport, get driven to your hotel in Pattaya. Check-in and spend the rest of your day at leisure. You can explore the Sanctuary of Truth, entirely constructed from wood depicting themes from Buddhism. You can also stroll at Jomtien Beach, known for its wide, sandy shoreline & tranquil waters. Next, you can visit Art In Paradise Museum, featuring 3D art installations. Afterward, return to your hotel.

days.title: Day Trip to Coral Island
days.desc: Today, get transferred to Bali Hai Pier and hop on a speedboat to Coral island. There, marvel at the stunning turquoise waters & beautiful sandy beaches. You can enjoy a variety of activities such as snorkeling among colorful marine life, taking a thrilling ride on a jet-ski, or gliding high above the water while parasailing. You can also simply soak up the sun at Tawaen Beach. Conclude your island adventure with a scenic speedboat ride back to Pattaya, followed by getting driven to your hotel.

days.title: Transfer to Bangkok | Chao Phraya River Dinner Cruise
days.desc: Post check-out from your hotel, get driven to Bangkok. Upon arrival, check-into your hotel and rest for some time. Later, get driven to Asiatique Pier for your scenic cruise on Chao Phraya River. Glide past iconic landmarks like the Grand Palace, Wat Arun, and vibrant riverside markets. Enjoy panoramic views of historic temples and bustling life along the riverbanks. Next, savor delicious dinner onboard and enjoy Thai performances. Afterwards, get driven back to your hotel from Asiatique Pier.

days.title: Day Trip to Safari World
days.desc: Today, board your transfer for an exciting day at the Safari World. Explore Thailand's largest open zoo, home to more than 400 species of animals. You can observe animals like lions, giraffes, and elephants in their natural habitat at Safari World. Next, discover the Marine Park’s stunning aquatic species and enjoy spectacular shows with dolphins, sea lions, and birds. Afterwards, get driven back to your hotel for a comfortable overnight stay.

days.title: Flight to Phuket
days.desc: In the morning, check-out from your hotel and get driven to Bangkok Airport for your flight to Phuket. Upon arrival in Phuket, get transferred to your hotel. Check-in and spend your day at leisure. You can explore Phuket Trickeye Museum, featuring a variety of themed zones. Next, you can visit Patong Beach, famous for its energetic nightlife with numerous bars, nightclubs, and entertainment venues lining the streets. Later, return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Phuket City Tour
days.desc: Today, get driven for a city tour of Phuket. Begin with a visit to Wat Chalong, Phuket's largest and most revered Buddhist temple, known for its stunning architecture. Then, wander through Old Phuket Town, where you can admire well-preserved Sino-Portuguese buildings. Finally, head to Karon View Point for breathtaking views of the Andaman Sea. Afterwards, get driven to your hotel.

days.title: Day Trip to Phi Phi Island
days.desc: Today, get driven to Phuket Marina and board a speedboat to the Phi Phi Islands. Begin at the iconic Maya Bay, renowned for its stunning beauty. Next, visit Loh Samah Bay, known for its vibrant marine life. Explore the Viking Cave, where ancient paintings adorn the walls and visit Monkey Beach, where you can observe playful macaques. Later, head to Koh Phi Phi Lee, where you can engage in water activities, before returning to Phuket Marina. Afterwards, get driven back to your hotel.

days.title: Day Trip to Tiger Kingdom | Leisure Time
days.desc: Today, get driven to the Tiger Kingdom & observe a variety of tigers there. You can get close to tigers of various ages, from playful cubs to majestic adults. Capture photos with the tigers and learn about their behavior and care. Afterward, get driven to your hotel and spend the rest of your day at leisure. You can visit Tha Rua Shrine, known for its traditional Chinese architectural style. Next, you can explore Phuket Aquarium, showcasing a variety of marine life. Later, return to your hotel.
